newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH PREMIER LEAGUE GATES INCREASE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH PREMIER LEAGUE GATES INCREASE.

text.p: English premier league attendances have risen this season, with the influx of top foreign players and the success of Euro 96 contributory factors.
Premier league press officer Mike Lee said on Thursday: "We are still waiting for official figures relating to the games so far but there is a slight increase and the signs are very encouraging.

"I wouldn't like to put Euro 96 in isolation as the reason for the gates going up. After all, attendances in the premier league at the end of 1995-96 were up 30 percent compared to the inaugural 1992-93 season.

"But there is no doubt that Euro 96 has been a positive factor and I think the new brand of international stars in the premier league is another reason. People are enjoying the games they are seeing, the product they are getting."
"These factors, plus better facilities at grounds, better catering, a better environment in which to watch football, are all mixed in as reasons for the success of attendances."
